subject: I wasn't going to send this challenge
preview_text: But then I saw what 3 days of using this app did for 92% of couples. See the difference yourself.
body_paragraphs: I almost deleted this email. Then I remembered the couple who told me this 3-day challenge saved their Friday nights. They were stuck in the same dinner-and-a-movie loop, feeling like roommates instead of lovers. Sound familiar?

Here's the thing: routine kills romance slowly. One boring date leads to another, and before you know it, you're both scrolling phones instead of talking. But I've seen what happens when couples commit to just three intentional dates in a row. The spark doesn't just come back—it grows stronger.

That's why I'm challenging you to use SoulPlan's AI date generator for three days straight. Open the app, tap 'Surprise Me,' and let it suggest something based on your actual interests—not another tired restaurant. You'll get budget-friendly to luxury options, local spots you've never noticed, and a shared wishlist to dream together. No repeats, no regrets.

Try it now: open SoulPlan, start the 3-Day Spark Challenge, and plan your first date today. I dare you to see the difference after day three. P.S. The couples who finish this challenge say they feel closer than ever—and they never look at date night the same way again.
